methods.evidence: Delivers a message into the session, which Claude reads on its next turn and acts on; the write to the transport is the only acknowledgement, so delivery is not steering and not processing
A reverse request carrying request_id, tool_name, description and input_preview for a tool call the session is waiting on; answering it runs or refuses that call
Answers the pending request named by request_id with allow or deny, which runs or refuses the tool call

qualification_note: Qualified against Claude Code 2.1.278 (npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code) and the Channels reference at code.claude.com/docs/en/channels-reference, read 2026-09-20; all three notification names are present in the installed 2.1.278 executable. The correlation identifier is params.request_id, because every message on this surface is a JSON-RPC notification and carries no id member. The table routes and classifies; it carries no mapping from a relayed permission request's fields onto an approval resource, and this package ships no decoder. Volatile forwarding is untested. docs/qualification-notes.md records what each claim was checked against.
